title: Keep serving while a new index catches up
description: Inject write pressure or a replica loss, then choose a cutover contract and see whether the new generation is fresh enough to serve.

scenarios.label: Daily mutations
scenarios.detail: Normal inserts, replacements, and tombstones arrive continuously.
scenarios.risk: Freshness slips if sustained mutation demand exceeds indexing capacity.

scenarios.label: Embedding migration
scenarios.detail: A backfill creates a new embedding generation while live writes continue.
scenarios.risk: Mixing generations makes scores and ranking behavior incompatible.

scenarios.label: Deletion surge
scenarios.detail: A privacy deletion batch must reach every serving replica and checkpoint.
scenarios.risk: Retiring tombstones too early can let delayed updates resurrect records.

cutovers.label: Immediate alias flip
cutovers.detail: Move traffic without waiting for a serving checkpoint.

cutovers.label: Checkpoint-gated flip
cutovers.detail: Keep the old generation serving until the new index covers the target offset.

cutovers.label: Dual-write and shadow
cutovers.detail: Feed both generations, compare queries, and cut over after quality and freshness pass.
